en: The postcard features a picturesque river landscape with green hills, trees, and a river (identified as 'Indalselfven i Indal'). A woman is seen standing with a goat in the foreground, under some tall trees. The back of the postcard shows Swedish text for addressing and a 5 öre Swedish stamp with a postmark. There is cursive handwriting on both the front (message) and back (address).
